architectureVerification.outerInstallerStub: PE32 executable (GUI) Intel 80386, Nullsoft Installer self-extracting archive - a standard 32-bit NSIS bootstrapper; this is normal NSIS behavior on Windows and does NOT mean the installed application is 32-bit
architectureVerification.installedApplicationBinary: cip-desktop.exe: PE32+ executable (GUI) x86-64, confirmed via `file` and `objdump -f` (file format pei-x86-64, architecture i386:x86-64) - the actual application that runs after installation is genuinely x64
architectureVerification.method: file(1) and x86_64-w64-mingw32-objdump -f, run directly against both the installer and the embedded application binary in this build environment

releaseCandidateStatement: This is the Phase 3.4 SOFTWARE RELEASE CANDIDATE for Windows x64. It is a real, verifiable build artifact - not a placeholder, not a simulation, not a fabrication.
physicalHardwareStatement: Physical hardware qualification has NOT been performed in the build environment. This installer has not been installed, launched, or tested on any real Windows machine, including the target HP EliteBook 830 G6. No real microphone, no real Whisper transcription, no real second display/projector, and no real operator workflow has been exercised against this artifact. Xvfb, simulated audio, virtual displays, automated tests, and cross-compilation success are Environment A/B evidence only and are never substituted for Environment C (real hardware) evidence anywhere in this project's documentation.
githubReleaseStatus: NOT CONFIGURED - no .github/workflows directory exists in this repository, and no GitHub Release has been created for this artifact. This installer is available only via this repository's working tree (release/windows/), not via GitHub Releases or any CI/CD pipeline.
obtainingWithoutDeveloperTooling: The file at release/windows/Church Intelligence Platform_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe can be copied/transferred directly (e.g. via a git clone of this repository, a direct file download, or a USB drive) to the target Windows machine and run there. Running the installer on Windows requires none of: Claude Code, Rust, Cargo, Node.js, npm, or the CIP source tree - only the .exe file itself.
